meta.name: escalation-management
meta.description: Handles customer situations that have exceeded normal support — severity assessment, incident communication, executive escalation, and recovering a relationship after a failure. Use this when a customer issue is escalating or has gone to leadership, during a customer-affecting outage, when a major account is at risk, when a relationship needs repairing after a failure, or to design the escalation path itself.

copy.tagline: 让客户升级得到专业处置与关系修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要处理客户升级或修复重要客户关系
copy.tagline_en: Resolve serious customer issues and mend relationships
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage escalated customer issues and need to rebuild trust

howto.what: Claude会接管客户升级处理：先评估影响程度，指派专人负责，按承诺节奏向客户同步进展（即使无新消息），并区分致歉与解释；之后会安排高管简报、推动关系修复，并在事后复盘升级原因。
howto.when: 当客户问题已升级或上报领导层、发生影响客户的事故，或重要客户面临风险等场景时触发。

say.text: 请从客户角度评估这个升级问题的严重程度，并给出判断依据。
say.note: Claude会按客户损失来定级，并说明理由。

say.text: 为这次事故制定沟通节奏，并草拟一条发给客户的进展更新。
say.note: Claude会给出定时同步计划及消息模板。

say.text: 准备高管会前简报：背景、已做措施、可承诺事项和勿承诺事项。
say.note: Claude会输出简报，避免高管过度承诺。

howto.what_en: Claude manages escalations: assesses customer impact, assigns an owner, communicates on cadence, separates acknowledgment from explanation, avoids over-promising, briefs executives, drives recovery, and reviews failures.
howto.when_en: Trigger when a customer issue escalates or reaches leadership, during a customer-affecting outage, or when a major account is at risk.

say_en.text: Assess this escalation's severity from the customer's perspective.
say_en.note: Claude will grade impact by customer cost.

say_en.text: Set a communication cadence for this incident and draft a customer update.
say_en.note: Claude will propose a schedule and message template.

say_en.text: Prepare an exec brief: background, actions, commitments, no-promise list.
say_en.note: Claude will output a briefing to avoid over-commitment.
